reading:
True North Data Solutions is headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, a foreign private operator whose data center footprint extends into the United States. The company's own site does not state a founding year or ownership structure.

True North describes a portfolio of more than 10 project sites across three countries on two continents, with 673 megawatts of capacity and growing. The company specializes in air-cooled and liquid immersion cooling data center solutions, alongside professional hosting services and technology optimization for enterprise computing environments, a technical specialization, particularly liquid immersion cooling, that distinguishes it from the air-cooled wholesale and colocation models most other operators in this registry describe.

The registry here tracks 6 True North facilities, all in Virginia, concentrated in the Leesburg area of Northern Virginia's data center corridor, the same power-constrained region carrying dense AWS, CloudHQ, and NTT buildout recorded elsewhere in this registry. As a Canadian-headquartered operator with a stated multi-country footprint, True North's full facility list likely extends beyond Virginia and beyond the United States, a scope this registry does not track outside its US-focused facility rows.
